shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure(s) rendered in low relief
horizontal dividing band/line across the surface
schematic incised linear detail on a rounded-topped upright slab
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief human imagery with a prominent circular disc and a horizontal band crossing the field on an upright, round-topped slab, but these are generic correspondences. A shows one massive frontal figure whose head, arms and pendant disc fill the entire surface in bold reduced volumes, whereas B shows many small finely incised figures seated or standing in profile around offering tables, organised into two stacked registers with rows of sign-like marks — different subjects, scale conventions and compositional schemes.
